summary_md: **Dash Dash ([@dashdash_design](https://x.com/dashdash_design/status/2116179186528505879))** built **Kara**, an open character designer on your own ComfyUI: pick menus, drag a face into shape and it writes the prompt and outputs a clean character sheet; installers and an online API-key version exist ([DashDashDesign/Kara](https://github.com/DashDashDesign/Kara), [kara.dashdash.design](https://kara.dashdash.design)).
